fields.label: reconciliation_id
fields.description: Unique ID for this reconciliation flow.

fields.label: execution_mode
fields.description: Where this reconciliation flow runs, and the field that gates which of the fields below are legal. job runs it as a 05_reconciliation_engine.py job task, exactly as today, and is the default because existing job resources already run reconciliation tasks against onboarded rows. pipeline registers it inside its dataflow group's Lakeflow pipeline update as a third flow type -- the published classified/metrics/mismatch datasets and the heal (append-back) lane. pipeline_audit_only registers the comparison, metrics and dq_config expectations in-pipeline but leaves healing in job mode. Both pipeline modes require dataflow_group_id, an append-only source producer, and read_mode batch on every side.

fields.label: dataflow_group_id
fields.description: The dataflow group whose Lakeflow pipeline this flow is registered into. Required when execution_mode is pipeline or pipeline_audit_only -- a group-less reconciliation flow has no pipeline update to live in. Usually this spec's own dataflow_group_id; naming another group registers the flow inside that group's pipeline instead. Stays optional in job mode, where the standalone engine handles the group-less case.

fields.label: publish_schema
fields.description: Schema, inside the hosting pipeline's own catalog, where this flow's recon__<reconciliation_id>__<target_id>__metrics and __mismatch datasets are published. Since v1.7.07 this is the only thing that publishes: leave it empty and the audit datasets stay pipeline-scoped (a dq_config gate still works, nothing is exported). Required when run_log_capture or mismatch_log_capture is true, and for a healing pipeline-mode flow. Rejected on presence when execution_mode is job -- a job-mode flow publishes none of those datasets.

fields.label: two_tier_verification
fields.description: Runs a cheap Phase 1 per-side fingerprint (row_count plus XOR-fold of framework hash columns) first, only falling through to full join on mismatch.

fields.label: logging_config.run_log_capture
fields.description: Per-flow gate on run-log writes. DEFAULT false since v1.7.3 (was true through v1.7.2) -- reconciliation is silent by default, so leaving this unset means NO reconciliation_run_log or reconciliation_result rows and no recon__*__metrics dataset. Set true to opt in; required true when the flow declares dq_config.rules. Overridable at runtime by the recon_run_log_capture parameter.

fields.label: logging_config.mismatch_log_capture
fields.description: Per-flow gate on mismatch-log writes. DEFAULT false since v1.7.3 (was true through v1.7.2) -- leaving this unset means NO reconciliation_mismatch_log rows and no recon__*__mismatch dataset. Set true to opt in. Overridable at runtime by the recon_mismatch_log parameter.

fields.label: error_handling.on_failure
fields.description: fail raises an error, warn logs and continues.

title: Source dataset
subtitle: source_config — the baseline dataset to compare from.

title: Target dataset
subtitle: One reconciliation flow compares one source against one target table, resolved from catalog, schema and table.

fields.label: target_configs[]
fields.description: Target comparison dataset.

fields.label: target_id
fields.description: Identifies this target in run and mismatch logs.

fields.label: target_catalog
fields.description: Unity Catalog catalog of the target table. Composed into three-part table name on save.

fields.label: target_schema
fields.description: Schema of the target table. Composed into three-part table name on save.

fields.label: target_table
fields.description: Target table name. Composed into three-part table name on save.

fields.label: read_mode
fields.description: At most one side of a given target's comparison may be streaming. Rejected on presence with value 'streaming' when execution_mode is 'pipeline' or 'pipeline_audit_only': the in-pipeline comparison is a whole-snapshot batch classification, and a stream-static join supports only inner and left_outer, which cannot express MISSING_IN_SOURCE.

fields.label: task_run_id_column
fields.description: When the task_run_id parameter is set, narrows this side's read to that run's rows. Reconciliation is triggered-only as of v1.4.0. Rejected on presence when execution_mode is 'pipeline' or 'pipeline_audit_only': no stable per-update key exists inside a Lakeflow update, so the narrowing would be a silent no-op. Use filter_condition instead.

fields.label: filter_condition
fields.description: Boolean SQL condition applied after read. Supports ${param} substitution.

fields.label: data_standardization_sql
fields.description: Column-level cleanup before matching. Same restricted grammar as ingestion.

fields.label: hash_precomputed
fields.description: Reuse existing __framework_hash_key and __framework_hash_value instead of recomputing.

fields.label: comparison_direction
fields.description: source_to_target self-heals missing records, target_to_source audits orphaned records, both does each.

fields.label: append_target_table
fields.description: Where self-healed records are appended. Required when direction includes source-to-target.

title: Matching & healing
subtitle: How records are paired, which columns are compared, and how missing rows are reshaped before append.

fields.label: match_keys
fields.description: Columns identifying the same logical record across datasets.

fields.label: compare_columns
fields.description: Columns compared for drift after key matching. Defaults to all columns.

fields.label: transform_sql
fields.description: Reshapes missing records before append when schemas differ. Must read FROM _reconciliation_unmatched_records.

title: Reconciliation data quality
subtitle: dq_config — expectations attached to this flow's one-row __metrics dataset. The first declarative way a reconciliation threshold can fail a pipeline update. In-pipeline execution modes only.

fields.label: dq_config.rules[]
fields.description: Expectations evaluated against the one-row metrics dataset this flow publishes, e.g. value_drift_count = 0. Additive: it does not repurpose error_handling.on_failure, which keeps its exception-level try/except meaning. Rejected on presence when execution_mode is job -- a job task has no dataset to attach expectations to.

fields.label: rule_id
fields.description: Unique expectation identifier.

fields.label: action
fields.description: warn logs and keeps the metrics row, drop removes it, fail aborts the pipeline update. quarantine is deliberately not offered: it is rejected for a reconciliation flow because a one-row metrics dataset has nothing to quarantine.

fields.label: expression
fields.description: Boolean Spark SQL expression over the metrics columns (source_row_count, target_row_count, missing_in_target_count, missing_in_source_count, value_drift_count).
